issue.title: Fix the orphaned commit_vars_finalizer SDD prompt breaking sase validate
issue.description:
`just check` / `just validate` fails its SASE-validation stage with:

    error: 202607/prompts/commit_vars_finalizer.md: 'plan' target does not exist: ../commit_vars_finalizer.md (link-missing-target)

The prompt file was committed to the plans sidecar (commit 750c177b, 'Add SDD prompt for commit_vars_finalizer') but the companion plan `202607/commit_vars_finalizer.md` was never added, so `sase plan links validate` reports 1 error on every run. This makes `just check` end red in every workspace regardless of what the agent changed; all ten sase-bg phase agents had to report it as unrelated pre-existing drift, which is exactly the noise that trains agents to ignore red checks.

Follow-up: either author/restore the missing `202607/commit_vars_finalizer.md` plan or remove the orphaned prompt file from the plans sidecar.

Discovered while landing epic sase-bg (not caused by it).
